name: Shadrix Silverquill
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a master wordsmith who oversees diplomacy at the Forum of Amity.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Shadrix Silverquill founds the Forum of Amity to strengthen the peace formed at the end of the Blood Age.
timeline.quote: the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.
